The part arrives with its true faces (flat, cylindrical, conical…) as an “Imported” feature: you can view it, measure it, put it in a drawing, calculate its volume and mass, and draw sketches and add features on top. It does not bring the feature history with it.
L'unità di misura è scritta nel file e v: The unit of measure is written in the file and is converted to millimeters automatically. SolidWorks keeps the Y axis up; Inventor, Fusion and FreeCAD often Z: if the part arrives lying down check the box (it can also be changed later, by double-clicking “Imported”).
